title: USA — Presidential Election 2020
description: Elecciones presidenciales con alta polarización, protestas BLM, pandemia COVID y questionamiento de resultados electorales.
sources: Pew Research Center (2020): Political Polarization in America
data_notes: P represents polarization_index (units: index). Series reconstructed from published research sources (empirical_estimated). Observation operator H: std(opinion) / 1.0. At Tier 1 (< 500 observations), only aggregate parameters can be calibrated against this case; see docs/validation/PROMPT_CALIBRACION_EQUIPO_AGENTES.md.
observation_operator_description: Polarization index: P escalates throughout 2020 election cycle. Observation operator H: std(opinion_dimension) normalized by half-range.
